name: My back hurts from lifting boxes at my Provo, Utah job but symptoms started days later, is this still a work injury claim?

mainEntity.name: My back hurts from lifting boxes at my Provo, Utah job but symptoms started days later, is this still a work injury claim?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, delayed back pain from work lifting qualifies in Utah as cumulative trauma claim if reported promptly and medically linked.
